decisions.reason: A multi-model operator line is a low-cost complement to the core garage door business, and nothing suggests its value has failed to materialize, so the option stays open.

Rising energy-efficiency requirements keep the upside of the insulated glazed door high, but its minor website presence and the firm's habit of pruning overlapping glazed variants raise the risk that it is consolidated.
Its own-page presentation shows continued commitment, and after the overlapping glazed door D was dropped it is the surviving variant, so keeping it costs little relative to its value.
